_about: LGIC_LGCTFM round 9 fixed input. THE ONE CARRIER of the record shape (S85). ONE cell, cut on 1.0.0_SA_CTO's L10 round-8 analysis @b24a81c4d3 s.5 and 3.0.0_SA_CVO's L9 @2bb57f01f8. Round 8 STANDS; L1R8-AC4 PASS; five rows GRADUATED (S50-S54); no PRD addendum owed.

THE_POPULATION_IS_THE_SEVEN_STILL_LIVE_R.claim: held -- the analysis s.5 items 1 and 2
THE_POPULATION_IS_THE_SEVEN_STILL_LIVE_R.the_analysis_verbatim: Round 9 takes: (1) the liveness re-read, cut per s.4 -- shared tree, or base sha printed per verdict line -- and using the WINDOW method of s.3 rather than a subject grep. (2) The 7 STILL-LIVE rows, now measured as genuinely live (0 of 7 stale), as the remedy population. (3) Nothing else.
THE_POPULATION_IS_THE_SEVEN_STILL_LIVE_R.and_the_cell_RE_DERIVES_it: this list is a CONTROL ON THE FRAMING. The cell reads the round-8 liveness record's STILL-LIVE set itself and the arm compares by SET EQUALITY -- an inherited list is the shape this project has hit five times.

WHY_THIS_CELL_DISPOSITIONS_RATHER_THAN_S.claim: measured -- 2.0.0_SA_COO~G at the cut, reading all seven routed acts at HEAD
WHY_THIS_CELL_DISPOSITIONS_RATHER_THAN_S.the_finding: THE SEVEN ROUTED ACTS ARE NOT SEVEN OF THE SAME THING, AND TWO OF THEM CANNOT BE EXECUTED AS WRITTEN.
WHY_THIS_CELL_DISPOSITIONS_RATHER_THAN_S.the_collision_stated_plainly: S18 and W1-S21 both ask that arms be added to or documented in check_lt_r1.py -- a PINNED FIXED INPUT OF A CLOSED ROUND. LGIC_ENFORCE round 16 ruled, and its L9 and L10 upheld, that a retirement or annotation is recorded by an ADDITIVE SIBLING and NEVER by an edit to a pinned fixed input, because editing it after that round's proofs were pinned against it is the stale-proof hazard. The route did not see this collision; the round-8 liveness cell RECORDED it and correctly did not resolve it.
WHY_THIS_CELL_DISPOSITIONS_RATHER_THAN_S.so_the_cell_does_both_halves: it EXECUTES what is executable and DISPOSITIONS all seven with a class and a reason. It does not quietly skip the five it cannot do, and it does not force an edit the estate has ruled against.
WHY_THIS_CELL_DISPOSITIONS_RATHER_THAN_S.non_application: this is not a licence to reclassify a remedy as UNEXECUTABLE because it is hard. The class is reserved for an act whose execution would violate a standing ruling, and the row must NAME the ruling and the pinned path.

EVERY_VERDICT_LINE_STATES_ITS_BASE_SHA.claim: held -- the analysis s.4, adopting 3.0.0_SA_CVO's sentence verbatim as the ruling
EVERY_VERDICT_LINE_STATES_ITS_BASE_SHA.the_ruling_verbatim: A LIVENESS CELL CANNOT BE ISOLATED -- ISOLATION IS EXACTLY THE THING IT IS MEASURING AGAINST. The remedy is the CUT, not the worker: such a cell runs IN THE SHARED TREE, or STATES ITS BASE SHA IN EVERY VERDICT LINE.
EVERY_VERDICT_LINE_STATES_ITS_BASE_SHA.applied_here: this worker holds a worktree (Rule 14b is NOT traded away -- the carve-out is one cell class, not a weakening). So the mechanical bar is the second branch: EVERY row in the record carries base_sha, and the arm REFUSES a row without one.
EVERY_VERDICT_LINE_STATES_ITS_BASE_SHA.why_that_is_enough: a reader who knows the base sha can tell a TRUE absence from a FROZEN one. The 2-of-23 miss in round 8 was invisible precisely because no verdict line said which tree it was read in.
EVERY_VERDICT_LINE_STATES_ITS_BASE_SHA.and_the_window_method: any liveness re-read this cell performs enumerates the COMMIT WINDOW and inspects what each commit touched -- never a grep of commit SUBJECTS for a row id. S54's method has no author-cooperation blind spot; the subject grep returned 0 for S42, the row two seats confirmed was falsified.

the_judgment_criterion_quantifies_over_t.claim: held -- the round-8 analysis s.2, the bar-writing rule its own author took against himself
the_judgment_criterion_quantifies_over_t.the_rule_verbatim: WHEN A DEFECT'S MECHANISM IS UNIFORM OVER A PARTITION, THE CRITERION MUST QUANTIFY OVER THE PARTITION, NOT OVER THE BUCKET WHERE THE COST IS HIGHEST.
the_judgment_criterion_quantifies_over_t.applied_here: the expensive bucket is obviously UNEXECUTABLE-AS-ROUTED, because that is where a cell could hide work it simply did not do. AC4 therefore names ALL FIVE classes and asks whether each row's class is right at the bytes -- a remedy wrongly marked EXECUTED is exactly as bad, and last round both misses landed in the bucket the criterion did not name.

stale_proof_bar.claim: held -- the repaired predicate with both residuals
stale_proof_bar.statement: SET EQUALITY against the proofs that could actually be stale; the COUNT is informational; a failed retrieval RAISES; ONE ordered git log over all watched paths.

not_in_this_round_and_why.editing check_lt_r1.py: REFUSED BY NAME. It is a CLOSED round's pinned fixed input and two routed acts ask for it. The cell RECORDS the collision with the ruling that blocks it; it does not resolve it and it does not perform it.
not_in_this_round_and_why.disarming any row: a disarm is the row owner's act (R-19) and all seven name 2.0.0_SA_COO~G. An issuer's worker disarming rows that issuer routed is self-certification at two removes. The cell's EXECUTED class records that the ACT was done; the DISARM remains the issuer's and the DISPOSITION remains 3.0.0_SA_CVO's at L9.
not_in_this_round_and_why.the W2-S36 mechanics edit: NOT a worker's act. CLAUDE.md's 'Changing this file' gives a law edit THREE surfaces -- commit, same-turn broadcast, push state -- and a worker has no send tool, so it cannot discharge the broadcast. Classed and routed, never performed here.
not_in_this_round_and_why.anything outside the seven: the analysis s.5 item 3 reads 'Nothing else.'
